name: Folder of exports, last one flagged
description: A white file-browser window titled 'exports': video files appear one by one down the list (dark play-icon tile, filename in mono, day label on the right like Mon, Tue, Wed), then the last file is highlighted with a soft tint and a tilted chip is stamped under it: red '✗ STILL NOT IT', or green '✓ APPROVED'.
use_when: Lines about endless revisions, versions piling up, never getting the right result, or finally getting sign-off: 'final_v2, final_FINAL...', 'you still don't get what you wanted', 'draft after draft'.

files.help: filenames in order, oldest first, e.g. ['final.mp4', 'final_v2.mp4']; keep each under ~26 characters

days.help: labels on the right, one per file; default Mon, Tue, Wed...; [] hides them

final_tag.help: chip under the last file; default 'Still not it' (bad) or 'Approved' (good); '' shows no chip

final_tone.help: 'bad' (red chip, orange tint) or 'good' (green chip and tint)
